# `channel-log/v1` — channels/<channel>.md — rolling chat log

<!-- AUTOGENERATED from `Glorbo.FileSpec.ChannelLogMd` by
     `mix glorbo.docs.file_formats`. Do not edit by hand;
     regen after changing the spec module. -->

Append-only chat channel. Body carries a sequence of
messages in the log format consumed by
`GlorboWeb.ChannelLive`. Rotation spawns sibling archives
under `<channel>.YYYY-MM.md` that link back via
`archive_of:` / `rotated_from:`.

## Frontmatter schema

**Required:** `kind`, `channel`

**Optional:** `created_at`, `rotated_from`, `archive_of`


## Canonical key order

When the formatter rewrites this file, keys appear in this order:

`kind`, `channel`, `created_at`, `rotated_from`, `archive_of`

Unknown keys fall after the known block, sorted alphabetically.

## Examples

```markdown
---
kind: channel-log/v1
channel: general
created_at: 2026-04-16T00:00:00Z
---
# #general

Company-wide channel. Append-only; Elixir is sole writer.
```
